verdict.rationale: telli documents voice cloning that gives an agent a custom voice (your own, a colleague's, or a voice actor's), which covers the core cloning and agent-use parts of the story. The only consent evidence concerns callers agreeing to call recording, which is a different control and earns no credit for voice-cloning consent. Missing for 10: a documented consent or verification process for the person whose voice is cloned, details on the cloning workflow and requirements, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can clone a custom brand voice and use it for my agents, with a documented consent process

citations.quote: Voice cloning lets you give your agent a custom voice (your own, a colleague's, or a professional voice actor's), so the agent sounds exactly the way you want on every call.
